name: okta
description: Okta identity integration — search and inspect users, list groups and their members, see a user's assigned apps, query the system log, add users to groups, and suspend users. Authenticates with a static SSWS admin API token (Authorization: SSWS {apiToken}) against your Okta org's /api/v1 endpoints, with cursor pagination via Link headers.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Okta identity and access management via the Okta admin API (SSWS token)

fields.label: Okta Org URL
fields.helpText: Your Okta org base URL, e.g. https://acme.okta.com (also acme.okta-emea.com or acme.oktapreview.com). No trailing slash or path.

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: SSWS admin API token created in Admin Console > Security > API > Tokens. Inherits the creating admin's permissions and expires after 30 days of non-use.

tools.name: okta.search_users
tools.description: Search Okta users by a simple name/email prefix (q) or a SCIM-style search expression, returning trimmed user summaries.

q.description: Simple prefix match against firstName, lastName, and email (e.g. "ada")

search.description: SCIM-style filter expression, e.g. profile.department eq "Engineering" or status eq "ACTIVE". Takes precedence over q.

tools.name: okta.get_user
tools.description: Get a single Okta user by id or login (email), including full profile, status, and lifecycle timestamps.

tools.name: okta.list_groups
tools.description: List Okta groups, optionally filtered by a name prefix.

q.description: Prefix match on the group name (e.g. "eng")

tools.name: okta.list_group_members
tools.description: List the users in an Okta group as trimmed summaries, following Link-header pagination up to the limit.

limit.description: Max members to return across pages (default 200, max 1000)

tools.name: okta.list_user_apps
tools.description: List the applications assigned to a user (id, label, status, sign-on mode).

userId.description: The Okta user id (e.g. 00u1abcd...); use okta.search_users or okta.get_user to find it

tools.name: okta.query_system_log
tools.description: Query the Okta system log (audit events) by time window, filter expression, or keyword, returning event type, actor, outcome, and targets.

filter.description: SCIM-style filter expression, e.g. eventType eq "user.session.start"

q.description: Keyword search across event fields (e.g. an email or app name)

tools.name: okta.add_user_to_group
tools.description: Add a user to an Okta group (group membership grants the group's app assignments and policies).

groupId.description: The Okta group id to add the user to

userId.description: The Okta user id to add

tools.name: okta.suspend_user
tools.description: Suspend an ACTIVE Okta user, blocking sign-in until unsuspended. Reversible in the Admin Console, but immediately cuts the user's access.

userId.description: The Okta user id to suspend (user must be in ACTIVE status)
